user.title: Connect to Nexo
user.description: The central unit's LAN card, as used by NexoVision.

data_description.host: IP address of the LAN card.
data_description.port: NexoVision service port, usually 1024. Port 1025 speaks a different protocol and will not work.
data_description.password: The same password NexoVision logs in with.

reconfigure.title: Change the connection
reconfigure.description: Leave the password empty to keep the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the central unit.
error.invalid_auth: The central unit rejected the password.

abort.already_configured: This central unit is already configured.

menu.title: Nexo

menu_options.remove: Remove a gate, door or button

resources.title: Sensors to import
resources.description: The list is read from the central unit.

data_description.binary_sensors: On when violated: a door open, motion detected. Set what each one is under "Show as" in its entity settings.
data_description.analog_sensors: Raw values without a unit - the central unit does not say what is wired in.

add_cover.title: Gate or door
add_cover.description: Driven by logic commands: rules in the central unit with an external command ("Komenda zewnętrzna") condition.

data_description.open_command: At most 7 characters. A mistyped command is accepted by the central unit and silently does nothing.
data_description.reed_sensor: Optional. Reads closed or not closed - the only thing that confirms the gate moved. Without it the state is unknown.
data_description.open_only_when_closed: Reads the reed switch right before opening and refuses otherwise. Stops a second open command from halting a gate in motion. Leave it off where stopping part-way is wanted.

add_button.title: Logic command button
add_button.description: Sends one logic command, for instance to release a door strike. Nothing confirms the result.

data_description.command: At most 7 characters. A mistyped command is accepted by the central unit and silently does nothing.

data_description.scan_interval: Each imported sensor is one query of roughly 50 ms, so a full sweep takes longer the more you import.

error.command_empty: The command must not be empty.
error.command_too_long: Logic commands are at most 7 characters.
error.guard_needs_reed_sensor: Needs a reed switch to check.

abort.cannot_list: Cannot read the resource list from the central unit.
abort.not_loaded: The integration is not running. Fix the connection first.
